---
title: "Step 11: Modeling Parameters"
---

## Timestep Size

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **TIMESTEP SIZE** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Finite difference modeling parameter. |
| Units | yr. |
| Typical Values | 0.01 to 1 yr. |
| Source of Data | A rule of thumb is to make sure the timestep size is smaller than:<br>(X-Direction cell size) ÷ (groundwater Darcy velocity) |
| How to Enter Data | Enter directly. |

</div>

## Maximum Number of Iterations

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **MAXIMUM NUMBER OF ITERATIONS** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Finite difference modeling parameter. The maximum number of Gauss Siedell iterations to prevent an endless convergence loop. |
| Units | Unitless. |
| Typical Values | 100-500. |
| Source of Data | Trial and error. If the simulation doesn't converge, sometimes it can help to increase the number of iterations (but not often). |
| How to Enter Data | Enter directly. |

</div>

## Convergence Tolerance

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **CONVERGENCE TOLERANCE** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Finite difference modeling parameter. Convergence tolerance during the Gauss Siedell iteration. |
| Units | ug/L or mg/L or kg/m³. |
| Typical Values | Typically, 5 - 8 orders of magnitude lower than the source concentration. |
| Source of Data | Take the (**INITIAL SOURCE CONCENTRATION**) and divide by 10,000,000. |
| How to Enter Data | Enter directly. |

</div>

## See Results Every

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **SEE RESULTS EVERY** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Time interval over which to plot results. |
| Units | yrs. |
| Typical Values | |
| Source of Data | |
| How to Enter Data | Enter directly. |

</div>

### New Site/Clear Data

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **NEW SITE/CLEAR DATA** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Clears ALL data in the Toolkit memory banks. Use this button to start a new project. |

</div>

### Save/Export Data

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **SAVE/EXPORT DATA** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Saves all model data. DO NOT ADD ANY EXTENSIONS TO FILE NAME WHEN SAVING. |

</div>

### Paste Example

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **PASTE EXAMPLE** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Clears ALL data in the Toolkit memory banks and pastes an example dataset.<br>The example dataset used in REMFluor-MD is obtained from Tutorial 7 of the original REMChlor model. |

</div>

### Load Data

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **LOAD DATA** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Loads data files saved through the Toolkit. DO NOT EDIT ANY TOOLKIT FILES. Editing files may cause the Toolkit to crash. |

</div>
